Name: All-in-one Friendship mod
Author: archseriph
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Better Friendship is a comprehensive overhaul of Stardew Valley's friendship system, giving you complete control over how friendships grow and decay. Customize every interaction — talking, gifting, birthdays, movie outings, and spouse kisses — with precise point values and per-category multipliers. Enable social spillover to automatically share friendship gains with NPCs' friends and family, add gift fatigue so repeated gifts lose effectiveness, apply decay customization, and receive on-screen notifications explaining friendship changes.
Everything is configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu with detailed tooltips and a built-in help guide.

View the readme inside the Docs tab for a more detailed explination.


[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]Customize any portion of the friendship system, with support for multiple spouses.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Create your own social circles for NPCs by editing the included social_circles.json.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Look at the Readme for what this mod can do.[/color]
